cases.sentence: Когда Левин вошел наверх, ___ его сидела у нового серебряного самовара за новым чайным прибором.
cases.translation: When Levin came upstairs, his wife was sitting at the new silver samovar with a new tea set.
cases.explain: «Жена» is the grammatical subject of «сидела», so it stands in the Nominative case.

cases.sentence: Когда Левин вошел наверх, жена его сидела у нового серебряного ___.
cases.translation: When Levin came upstairs, his wife was sitting at the new silver samovar.
cases.explain: The preposition «у» governs the Genitive case: «у самовара».

cases.sentence: Он, так недавно еще не смевший верить тому ___, что она может полюбить его, теперь чувствовал себя несчастным.
cases.translation: He, who so recently had not dared believe in the happiness that she could love him, now felt unhappy.
cases.explain: The verb «верить» governs the Dative case (верить чему): «верить счастью».

cases.sentence: Он поцеловал её ___, поцеловал волосы, опять поцеловал руку.
cases.translation: He kissed her hand, kissed her hair, again kissed her hand.
cases.explain: «Руку» is the direct object of the transitive verb «поцеловал», hence Accusative.

cases.sentence: Но что там он поссорился с ___ и поехал назад в Москву.
cases.translation: But there he had quarreled with his superior and gone back to Moscow.
cases.explain: The preposition «с» (with) governs the Instrumental case: «с начальником».

cases.sentence: В первом ___ Марья Николаевна писала, что брат прогнал её от себя без вины.
cases.translation: In the first letter Marya Nikolaevna wrote that his brother had driven her away without fault.
cases.explain: The preposition «в» governs the Prepositional case: «в письме».

reading.ru: Когда Левин вошел наверх, жена его сидела у нового серебряного самовара за новым чайным прибором.
reading.question: What was Kitty doing when Levin came upstairs?
options: She was sitting at a new silver samovar with a new tea set
She was playing with the children
reading.correct: She was sitting at a new silver samovar with a new tea set
reading.explain: When Levin came upstairs, his wife was sitting at the new silver samovar with a new tea set.

reading.ru: «Вишь, посадила меня ваша барыня, велела с ней сидеть», сказала Агафья Михайловна, дружелюбно улыбаясь на Ките.
reading.question: What did Agafya Mikhailovna say about being seated with Kitty?
options: That her mistress had seated her and told her to sit with her
That she refused to sit down
That she was too old to drink tea
reading.correct: That her mistress had seated her and told her to sit with her
reading.explain: Agafya Mikhailovna said her mistress had seated her and told her to sit with her, smiling warmly at Kitty.

reading.ru: «Вот я и прочла твое письмо», — сказала Китти, подавая ему безграмотное письмо.
reading.question: What did Kitty hand to Levin after reading it?
reading.explain: Kitty said she had read his letter and handed him an ungrammatical (illiterate) letter.

reading.ru: Представь, Долли возила к Сарматским на детский бал Гришу и Таню.
reading.question: According to Dolly's letter, where had she taken Grisha and Tanya?
options: To a children's ball at the Sarmatskys'
reading.correct: To a children's ball at the Sarmatskys'
reading.explain: Dolly had taken Grisha and Tanya to a children's ball at the Sarmatskys'.

reading.question: What costume did Tanya wear at the children's ball?
reading.explain: The text says Tanya was dressed as a marquise.

reading.ru: Он, покраснев, взял письмо от Марьи Николаевны, бывшей любовницы брата Николая, и стал читать его.
reading.question: Whose letter did Levin blush and begin reading?
options: A letter from Marya Nikolaevna, his brother Nikolai's former mistress
reading.correct: A letter from Marya Nikolaevna, his brother Nikolai's former mistress
reading.explain: Blushing, he took the letter from Marya Nikolaevna, his brother Nikolai's former mistress.

reading.ru: Она нашла Николая Дмитриевича, опять сошлась с ним в Москве и с ним поехала в губернский город, где он получил место на службе.
reading.question: What had happened between Marya Nikolaevna and Nikolai according to her new letter?
options: She had found him again, reunited with him in Moscow, and gone with him to a provincial town where he got a job
She had reported him to the police
reading.correct: She had found him again, reunited with him in Moscow, and gone with him to a provincial town where he got a job
reading.explain: The letter said she had found Nikolai, reunited with him in Moscow, and gone with him to a provincial town where he got a post.

reading.ru: Что такое?» «Она мне пишет, что Николай — брат при смерти.
reading.question: What news alarmed Levin in the letter?
options: That his brother Nikolai was dying
That his brother had gotten married
That his brother had won money
That his brother had moved abroad
reading.correct: That his brother Nikolai was dying
reading.explain: Levin's face changed when he read that his brother Nikolai was dying.

reading.ru: «И я с тобой можно?» — сказала она.
reading.question: What did Kitty ask Levin when he said he would go to his dying brother?
options: Whether she could come with him
Whether he would write to her
reading.correct: Whether she could come with him
reading.explain: Kitty asked, 'And may I come with you?'

reading.question: How did Levin respond, at first, to Kitty's wish to accompany him?
options: He said sternly that it was impossible
reading.correct: He said sternly that it was impossible

reading.ru: «Нет, это ужасно, быть рабом каким-то!» — вскрикнул Левин, вставая, и не в силах более удерживать свои досады.
reading.question: What did Levin exclaim in frustration during the argument?
options: That it was terrible to be some kind of slave
That he wished he had stayed single forever
reading.correct: That it was terrible to be some kind of slave
reading.explain: Levin cried out that it was terrible to be some sort of slave, unable to contain his vexation any longer.

reading.ru: Он поцеловал ее руку, поцеловал волосы, опять поцеловал руку.
reading.question: How did Levin try to comfort Kitty after the quarrel?
options: He kissed her hand, her hair, and her hand again
reading.correct: He kissed her hand, her hair, and her hand again
reading.explain: He kissed her hand, kissed her hair, and again kissed her hand.

reading.question: How was the quarrel between Levin and Kitty ultimately resolved?
options: It was decided they would travel together the next day
Kitty stayed home while Levin left alone
Levin refused to go at all
reading.correct: It was decided they would travel together the next day
reading.explain: It was decided that they would leave together the next day.
